BiblicalUsage: Bakar means to give the birthright — to make the firstborn, and to give the firstborn his double portion. The firstborn of the flock belongs to the Lord, the father shall not make the son of the beloved firstborn before the son of the hated, and Jeremiah hears the voice of a woman in travail, bringing forth her first child. The birthright is the first and best, and it belongs to God.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the firstborn is God's by right. Esau's sale of it is the warning that hangs over this whole word: never trade the first and best for a bowl of pottage.
